statements.t: In AUD, we look forward to engaging with the FDA in an End-of-Phase 2 meeting where we will leverage our strong RECLAIM data to discuss a Phase 3 registrational program.
Following the conclusion of the call, the webcast will be available for replay on the IR page of the Company’s website at www.altimmune.com .

The Company has used, and intends to continue to use, the IR portion of its website as a means of disclosing material non-public information and for complying with disclosure obligations under Regulation FD.
